studies.notes: Read the complete saved markdown through the references and Supporting Information notice, and checked the cited PDF pages with pymupdf. PDF and printed page numbers coincide. The total and arm counts are printed participation/group-composition counts, recorded as randomized/enrolled counts because Section 3.1 describes individual lottery assignment; no separate allocation-flow tally is printed. The available article does not print a distinct analyzed-person total for MCT flexibility, fluency, or originality (PDF p. 7, Table 3; PDF pp. 7-8, Section 6.1), or different participant totals for these creativity analyses. Table 1 is a demographic table, not an analysis-sample table. The existing extraction assigns analyzed counts of 60 to the ChatGPT and Google arms using the group sizes and no-exclusion statement. Under this check's instruction to retain enrolled counts and exclusions without deriving an analyzed count, those arm analyzed fields are also left null. The peer arm is explicitly described as 110 participants in 55 dyads (PDF pp. 3-4, Section 3.2 and Table 1). Section 3.1 states: "During task resolution, person A guided person B, who adopted a supportive and passive role without completing any work independently." The paper does not clarify whether the creativity scores represent both dyad members jointly or only the lead student, or how their individual baseline scores enter the analysis. Neither the dyad count nor degrees of freedom is used as an analyzed-person count, and no counts are added or subtracted. The exclusion count below transcribes the explicit word "none"; it is not used to calculate retention. The separate online appendix is identified on PDF p. 16 as "Appendix. Supporting document." It is not embedded in the PDF, no matching local supplement was found, and supplement-manifest.json lists no files for c089. The main text refers to scoring tables (PDF p. 6, Section 5) and exploratory Appendix Tables A1 and A3 (PDF pp. 11-12, Sections 7.4-7.5). Requests via Python urllib to https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/cae.70100 and then https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1002/cae.70100, with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, both failed with WinError 10013 (socket access forbidden). The appendix could not be inspected; any additional participant counts there remain unverified.
